title: Okinawa vs Jeju: Which Island Should You Visit?
verdict: Okinawa for beaches and diving, Jeju for hiking and volcanic landscapes. Choose based on which country you're already visiting.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Okinawa's turquoise coral reef water is world-class. Jeju's coastline is mainly volcanic rock.

categories.name: Hiking & Nature
categories.summary: Hallasan summit and 437km Olle Trails make Jeju a serious hiking destination.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Okinawa soba and champuru vs Jeju black pork BBQ and haenyeo seafood — both extraordinary.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Jeju holds a slight cost advantage, especially on diving and domestic flights from Seoul.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Both need a car, but Jeju's bus network makes car-free travel more feasible.

categories.name: Culture & History
categories.summary: The Ryukyuan Kingdom history and Shuri Castle give Okinawa surprising cultural depth.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Naha's Kokusai Street and American Village give Okinawa a meaningful evening scene.

faq.question: Is Okinawa or Jeju better for beaches?
faq.answer: Okinawa — turquoise coral reef water comparable to tropical Southeast Asia.

faq.question: Do you need a car on both islands?
faq.answer: Yes, strongly recommended for both. International driving license required.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Okinawa or Jeju?
faq.answer: Jeju holds a slight cost advantage, especially on diving and domestic flights.
